description: This file is a C header file defining exported API functions for the SLAP Obj Broker component. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the object broker, and contains licensing and module information.

methods.name: SlapCreateObjBroker
methods.description: Creates a new SLAP Object Broker instance with given context handles.

methods.name: SlapOboCreate
methods.description: Creates a SLAP Object Broker object with specified container and owner contexts.

methods.name: SlapOboRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified SLAP Object Broker object.

methods.name: SlapOboEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the SLAP Object Broker.

methods.name: SlapOboInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Object Broker object.
